summary: Iteration 7 verified end-to-end. Backend pytest (8/8 passing): GET/PUT /api/config with admin-only guard, defaultStatusId applied on POST /api/receivals when no statusId sent, auto-tick invoiceReceived when invoiceNumber provided via PUT /api/receivals/{id}, staff PUT invoiceNumber -> 403, /api/analytics admin-only with full payload (total, palletsTotal, invoicesPending, suppliersCount, statusCounts, supplierFrequency, daily/weekly/monthly). Frontend Playwright verified: admin sees nav-dashboard (staff does not); /dashboard redirects staff to /; Dashboard renders kpi-total/pallets/pending/suppliers, trend-daily/weekly/monthly tabs, status-card + supplier-freq-card with rows (2 recharts SVGs rendered). Slip totals badge slip-total-<id> shows exactly '2 slips · 3 entries · Σ 35.5' matching backend data. Row Edit dialog invoice-number save auto-ticks Invoice received (badge appears + API confirms invoiceReceived=true). Detail page: admin sees edit-detail-invoice-number and save-edit-btn persists change (invoiceReceived auto-ticks); staff sees edit-detail-btn but no edit-detail-invoice-number. Default status Select on /settings Statuses tab saves and /new page pre-selects it (combobox showed 'Pending').
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L546 auto-invoice: `if update.get('invoiceNumber')` will NOT re-set invoiceReceived when admin clears invoiceNumber back to '' — desirable, but consider explicit branch to also flip invoiceReceived=false when invoiceNumber is cleared, otherwise the checkbox stays ticked with no invoice number.
DashboardPage.js has no error state UI for 401/403; sets data=false and renders 'Could not load analytics.' — acceptable but no retry.
ReceivalListPage.js is 579 lines; iteration 6's suggestion to split Edit dialog / Filter panel still applies.
Slip model uses List[float] entries (no per-entry label) — badge math (count + sum) works, but PRD suggests each entry could have description; consider expanding schema when product needs it.

Layout desktop nav wraps in 'hidden md:flex' — nav-dashboard testid element still exists in DOM at mobile widths (hidden), while mobile bottom nav uses 'nav-dashboard-mobile'. Fine, but tests should target the size-appropriate selector.
seed_data_creation: Created one throw-away receival with 2 slips and 3 entries (sum 35.5) to verify slip-total badge and auto-invoice flow; deleted after test (DELETE 200). Default status is currently set to 'Pending' as a side-effect of testing (previously already set to Pending earlier per iteration_6 context); harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: reuse admin_headers/staff_headers fixtures in test_iteration7_dashboard.py; note POST /api/receivals requires auth (Bearer) plus PIN in body. Slip schema: {label: str, entries: List[float]} (no per-entry object). Frontend: login page defaults to Staff PIN tab; for admin use page.get_by_role('tab', name='Admin') then fill email/password and click 'Sign in'. Admin route is /settings (not /admin); statuses tab = data-testid=tab-statuses; default status selector = data-testid=default-status-select. Dashboard nav testid=nav-dashboard (desktop) / nav-dashboard-mobile (mobile). Row edit dialog: edit-<uuid> -> edit-invoice-number -> edit-save. Detail page edit: edit-detail-btn -> edit-detail-invoice-number -> save-edit-btn. Slip badge testid=slip-total-<uuid>.
